messages.text: I’ll trace how DD4hep handles these boundary exceptions and check the affected events to determine whether deposited energy is recovered, omitted, or zero.

The DD4hep 1.38 source catches this exception and returns before adding the step’s contribution to a hit. There is no retry or substitute cell in that path. I’m checking the configured energy filter next; it determines whether these failures can involve zero-deposit steps. The environment preflight still reports the known setup and lockfile drift.

**Positive-deposit steps are being omitted from the calorimeter hit record.** This is neither zero-only nor a logging-only error.

Read-only diagnosis against `b24f9db24b52f79c7586a52d0ca9b35e792606b9`:

- Both runs select `Geant4ScintillatorCalorimeterAction` and attach `edep0`. That filter accepts strictly positive `GetTotalEnergyDeposit()`. [Exact DD4hep 1.38 filter source](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/blob/142cbb7eb29ec4feafb1af9317fac38775872085/DDG4/plugins/Geant4SensDetFilters.cpp#L144)
- The action extracts the contribution, calls `cellID`, catches the exception and returns before adding energy or truth to the hit. There is no retry, recovery or substitute cell. [Action source, lines 465–489](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/blob/142cbb7eb29ec4feafb1af9317fac38775872085/DDG4/plugins/Geant4SDActions.cpp#L465)
- DD4hep classifies the arithmetic midpoint using the pre-step touchable. It logs segmentation exceptions and rethrows them. [Classification source](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/blob/142cbb7eb29ec4feafb1af9317fac38775872085/DDG4/src/Geant4SensDetAction.cpp#L323)

Full-precision logged positions show a concrete geometric mechanism: the endpoints are on/inside the annulus, while their midpoint falls inside its hole. Baseline midpoint radial deviations below the inner boundary are approximately `1.45e-6`, `1.07e-3` and `1.36e-6 mm`. The two candidate cases inspected give `4.03e-8` and `8.06e-6 mm`. These exceed the unchanged `1e-8 mm` guard; the largest is not a formatting or tiny rounding effect.

The retained ROOT file contains accepted hit contributions, not rejected steps. Consequently, its successful readback cannot establish deposited-energy completeness or recover the missing amount. Interleaved logs also lack reliable failed-step event/track identities.

The proposed independent step observer is the appropriate next evidence: bind event/track identity, sensitive volume, raw deposited energy, midpoint classification and exception totals, then reconcile accepted/rejected step energy with saved hits. Keep both existing runs diagnostic pending that evidence.
